title: Adder family fan-in bound
statement: Every circuit in the adder family is well formed: each gate has distinct input vertices, and every negation gate has exactly one input. Moreover, each gate has at most two input vertices.
hypotheses_covered: For every natural number input length, the corresponding circuit is well formed
Each gate's input list has no repetitions
Every negation gate has exactly one input
Every gate has at most two inputs
